coverage: Curated initial set; not an exhaustive cover-story index.
canon_policy: Manga cover serials are kept separate from main-arc events.

cover_stories.title: Buggy's Crew Adventure Chronicles
cover_stories.summary: Follows Buggy and his crew as they recover from their defeat and attempt to reunite.
cover_stories.story_use: A side-story template for scattered crew members, recovery, and rebuilding a pirate crew.

cover_stories.title: Diary of Koby-Meppo
cover_stories.summary: Follows Koby and Helmeppo as they begin their training and rise from low-level recruits.
cover_stories.story_use: Useful as a reference for off-screen character progression; Marine-focused content remains low priority in this project.

cover_stories.title: Jango's Dance Paradise
cover_stories.summary: Jango, while on the run, meets Fullbody through a dance contest; their encounter leads to an unexpected friendship and a new place in the Marines.
cover_stories.story_use: A template for rival-to-ally stories, social contests, mistaken identities, and NPCs whose loyalties change after shared experiences.

cover_stories.title: Hatchan's Sea-Floor Stroll
cover_stories.summary: After Arlong's defeat, Hatchan travels underwater, meets Camie and Pappag, and eventually starts a takoyaki business.
cover_stories.story_use: A model for redemption arcs, meeting recurring civilian NPCs, and turning a former enemy into a merchant or quest-giver.

cover_stories.title: Wapol's Omnivorous Hurrah
cover_stories.summary: After losing his kingdom, Wapol uses his unusual abilities to build a successful toy business and regain influence.
cover_stories.story_use: A model for displaced rulers, rebuilding an enterprise, economic progression, and morally ambiguous NPC entrepreneurs.

cover_stories.title: Ace's Great Blackbeard Search
cover_stories.summary: Ace's search for Blackbeard intersects with an island family, a letter, and a visit to a Marine base.
cover_stories.story_use: A delivery-and-infiltration side quest that can be reimagined with original characters and local factions.

cover_stories.title: Gedatsu's Accidental Blue-Sea Life
cover_stories.summary: After falling from Skypiea, Gedatsu becomes involved in digging a hot spring and settles into work at a bathhouse.
cover_stories.story_use: A template for absurd side quests, accidental settlement, local infrastructure projects, and former antagonists living ordinary lives.

cover_stories.title: Miss Goldenweek's Operation: Meet Baroque Works
cover_stories.summary: Miss Goldenweek gathers former Baroque Works agents and works to help free imprisoned colleagues.
cover_stories.story_use: A model for rescue chains, faction reunions, prison contacts, and the long-term consequences of a defeated organization.

cover_stories.title: Where They Are Now (Skypiea)
cover_stories.summary: A short follow-up cover sequence revisits characters and communities from the Skypiea storyline.
cover_stories.story_use: A compact example of post-arc callbacks: the player can receive a brief world update about people and settlements left behind.

cover_stories.title: Enel's Great Space Operations
cover_stories.summary: Enel reaches the moon, encounters automata and space pirates, and discovers a connection between the moon and sky-island peoples.
cover_stories.story_use: A long-term exploration seed for lost technology, ancient machines, and the world's wider geography.

cover_stories.title: Where They Are Now (Water 7)
cover_stories.summary: A short follow-up cover sequence checks in on characters from the Water 7 storyline after the crew departs.
cover_stories.story_use: A model for short epilogue scenes that update NPC locations, relationships, and local conditions without launching a full quest chain.

cover_stories.title: CP9's Independent Report
cover_stories.summary: The defeated CP9 agents seek funds for Lucci's treatment, protect a town from pirates, and go into hiding.
cover_stories.story_use: A model for defeated elite NPCs, medical expenses, fugitive networks, and temporary alliances with communities.

cover_stories.title: Straw Hat's Separation Serial
cover_stories.summary: The separated Straw Hat crew members each face events in the places where Kuma sent them.
cover_stories.story_use: A direct design reference for parallel character storylines, asynchronous companion progression, and reconnecting separated crew members.

cover_stories.title: From the Decks of the World
cover_stories.summary: People and communities encountered earlier react to news of the Straw Hats after the two-year separation.
cover_stories.story_use: A model for world simulation and news propagation: NPCs remember the player's reputation and react to major milestones while the player is elsewhere.

cover_stories.title: Caribou's Kehihihihi in the New World
cover_stories.summary: Caribou escapes custody, reaches an island, and becomes involved in a conflict affecting the local population.
cover_stories.story_use: A model for escaped captives, island-level political conflicts, and an antagonist whose actions can alter local conditions off-screen.

cover_stories.title: Solo Journey of Jinbe, Knight of the Sea
cover_stories.summary: Jinbe travels beneath the sea and investigates trouble involving a missing town.
cover_stories.story_use: A model for underwater exploration, missing-settlement investigations, and independent ally missions that run alongside the main voyage.

cover_stories.title: From the Decks of the World: The 500,000,000 Man Arc
cover_stories.summary: People around the world react to Doflamingo's defeat and the news of Luffy's 500-million-berry bounty.
cover_stories.story_use: A model for reputation updates, bounty reactions, local rumors, and changes in NPC behavior after world-scale events.

cover_stories.title: The Stories of the Self-Proclaimed Straw Hat Grand Fleet
cover_stories.summary: Follows members of the Grand Fleet after they depart from Dressrosa and shows how their separate voyages develop.
cover_stories.story_use: A reference for independent allied crews: each captain follows personal goals, makes different moral choices, and changes how the wider world sees the fleet.

cover_stories.title: 'Gang' Bege's Oh My Family
cover_stories.summary: Follows the Fire Tank Pirates as they travel and pursue a family reunion after the events of Whole Cake Island.
cover_stories.story_use: A model for family-driven side quests, travel, and crew loyalty that can evolve separately from the main protagonist.

cover_stories.title: Germa 66's Ahh... An Emotionless Excursion
cover_stories.summary: The Vinsmoke family fights to escape Big Mom's territory and recover family members held there.
cover_stories.story_use: A model for family rescue operations, faction escape routes, and parallel events involving a powerful organization outside the player's immediate location.

cover_stories.title: Oni Child Yamato's Golden Harvest Surrogate Pilgrimage
cover_stories.summary: Follows Yamato's journey across Wano to complete a pilgrimage while encountering people and problems in the recovering country.
cover_stories.story_use: A model for post-arc world recovery, regional travel, local disputes, and character-led side stories.
